title: [8] Dialog does not show real-time updates from other users
why_we_need_this: Currently a user has to leave and re-enter a dialog to see new messages or updates from another person. This breaks the real-time communication experience and makes the chat unusable for live conversations.
acceptance_criteria:
- Dialog displays new messages from other participants in real time without requiring page reload or re-entry
- Updates (edits, status changes) from other users appear automatically while the dialog is open
- No manual refresh or navigation action needed to see the latest state of the conversation
